covers: JSE session to about 16:15 SAST on Friday 13 November 2026, US October producer prices (released 15:30 SAST) and Wall Street pre-open headlines
headline: US wholesale inflation hits a near four-year high of 6.5%; JSE slips 0.6% into the close as the rand weakens to R16.97/$
summary: By about 16:15 SAST the JSE All Share was at 112,178.06 and the Top 40 at 104,265.89, both about 0.6-0.7% below Thursday's close, with SPAR down 4.0% and Naspers 1.5% lower (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 13 Nov 2026). US producer prices rose 0.3% in October, taking the annual rate to 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years, and the US 10-year yield was at 5.15%; MarketWatch reports stocks jumping after the data as Nvidia rebounds (CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 13 Nov 2026 15:34-16:02 SAST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX), 13 Nov 2026). The rand was at R16.97/$, 3.0% weaker than a week ago, gold at $3,890.90 (4.5% lower on the week) and Brent at $96.58 (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 6-13 Nov 2026).

items.title: US wholesale prices rise 0.3% in October; annual PPI rate 6.5%, highest in nearly four years
items.summary: CNBC reports October producer prices rose 0.3% on the month, putting the annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years. MarketWatch's live coverage calls it a four-year high. The figure adds to this week's bets on more Fed rate hikes; the US 10-year yield was at 5.15% on Friday, up from 4.86% a week earlier, and Investing.com reports Treasury yields logging their steepest weekly rise since April 2025.
items.source: CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 16:02 SAST; MarketWatch Bulletins headline, 13 Nov 2026 15:34 SAST; Investing.com headline, 13 Nov 2026 15:39 SAST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX), 6 and 13 Nov 2026

items.title: US stocks jump after the inflation data, led by a Nvidia rebound
items.summary: MarketWatch reports stocks jumping after the producer-price report, with Nvidia's rebound in focus; CNBC reports Nvidia shares inching higher as investors weigh Jensen Huang's departure. Nvidia closed Thursday at $166.19, down 4.3%, and MarketWatch reports the company has shed nearly $500 billion in market value this week.
items.source: MarketWatch Bulletins headline, 13 Nov 2026 15:53 SAST; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 16:23 SAST; MarketWatch headline, 13 Nov 2026 14:25 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NVDA), 12 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Microsoft says email queues are 'approaching normal levels' as Outlook issues persist
items.summary: CNBC reports Microsoft saying email queues are approaching normal levels, while MarketWatch reports the Outlook outage stretching into a second day. Microsoft closed Thursday at $523.00, up 0.4%.
items.source: CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 16:23 SAST; MarketWatch headline, 13 Nov 2026 16:22 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance MSFT), 12 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Dollar heads for its biggest weekly gain since September
items.summary: Investing.com reports the US dollar on course for its biggest weekly gain since September as inflation lifts Fed rate-hike expectations. CNBC reports the Fed, which had expected to cut rates this year, is now bracing for another fight against inflation.
items.source: Investing.com headline, 13 Nov 2026 15:45 SAST; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 12:00 SAST
